raw.details:
Overview

Kurukshetra — Where Ideas Meet Innovation is a technology and innovation event organized by Devkraft × CSI, Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri, Pune.

The event brings together students, technology enthusiasts, and industry professionals to encourage innovation, collaboration, and problem-solving.

Kurukshetra begins with Technical Inauguration, a podcast-style technical interaction featuring industry professionals who share their real-world experiences, career journeys, and industry insights. This is followed by an exciting 24-hour hackathon, where participants collaborate to develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges.

Join us to learn, build, collaborate, and turn your ideas into impactful solutions!

Event Details

  • Event Name: Kurukshetra 2026
  • Organizers: Devkraft × CSI
  • Institution: Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri, Pune
  • Event Dates: 16–17 October 2026
  • Venue: DPU Auditorium and college campus, Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri, Pune
  • Format: Technical Inauguration followed by a 24-hour hackathon
  • Expected Participation: Approximately 1,200 participants and 200 teams across the event
  • Hackathon Duration: 24 hours

Eligibility Criteria

  • The hackathon is open to college and university students.
  • Each team must consist of 2–4 members.
  • Inter-College and inter-branch teams are allowed.
  • All participants must complete registration through the official Unstop listing.
  • Participants must bring their own laptops and any other equipment required for development.

Hackathon Format

Phase 1: Registration

Participants can access the official Kurukshetra registration website through the Unstop listing. Teams must consist of 2–4 students from the same institution.

Phase 2: Technical Inauguration

Participants attend Technical Inauguration, featuring industry professionals sharing their experiences, insights, and career guidance.

Phase 3: Problem Statement Announcement

The official hackathon problem statements will be announced at the end of Technical Inauguration.

Participants will receive the problem statements and relevant instructions from the organizing committee. Teams can then select or work on the designated challenge according to the official guidelines.

Number of problem statements: To be announced by the organizers.

Phase 4: 24-Hour Development

Teams will have 24 hours to brainstorm, design, develop, test, and refine their solutions. Participants are expected to collaborate effectively and manage their time throughout the challenge.

Phase 5: Final Submission and Presentation

At the end of the 24-hour development period, teams must submit their projects according to the organizers' instructions and present their solutions to the judging panel.

Submission format, presentation duration, and evaluation schedule: To be announced by the organizers.

Rules and Regulations

  • Each team must contain 2–4 members from the same college or university.
  • Students from different college or branches may form a team.
  • Each participant may register with only one team.
  • Teams must work on the official problem statements announced at the end of Technical Inauguration.
  • Solutions must be developed within the official 24-hour hackathon duration.
  • Participants must bring their own laptops and ensure their development environment is ready.
  • Projects must be original. Pre-existing code, open-source libraries, APIs, and third-party tools may be used where appropriate, provided their use is properly acknowledged.
  • Plagiarism, misrepresentation, or copying another team's work may result in disqualification.
  • Teams must submit their projects before the deadline specified by the organizing committee.
  • Teams must comply with the submission, presentation, and technical guidelines communicated by the organizers.
  • Participants must maintain discipline and follow the rules of the venue and event.
  • The organizing committee reserves the right to address rule violations and resolve disputes in accordance with the event guidelines.

Judging Criteria

Projects may be evaluated on the following parameters:

  • Innovation and Creativity: Originality and uniqueness of the proposed solution.
  • Technical Implementation: Quality, functionality, and effective use of technology.
  • Problem-Solving: How effectively the solution addresses the selected problem statement.
  • Feasibility and Impact: Practical applicability, scalability, and potential real-world impact.
  • Presentation and Demonstration: Clarity of the project explanation and effectiveness of the final demonstration.

Final judging criteria and weightage: To be announced by the organizers.

Registration Process

  • Visit the official Kurukshetra listing on Unstop.
  • Click the registration link to be redirected to the official Kurukshetra website.
  • Complete the registration process on the website by providing the required participant and team details.
  • Form a team of 2–4 students from the same college or university.
  • Follow the instructions provided by the organizing committee to complete registration.
  • Stay updated through official communication channels for event updates and further instructions.

Important Instructions

  • Participants must follow the official schedule and instructions issued by the organizing committee.
  • The problem statements will be revealed at the end of Technical Inauguration.
  • Teams are responsible for bringing their own laptops and required development equipment.
  • Teams should ensure that their projects are ready for demonstration at the end of the 24-hour period.
  • Details concerning internet access, accommodation, meals, certificates, prizes, and intellectual property will be communicated by the organizers once finalized.

Be Part of Kurukshetra!

Learn from industry professionals at Technical Inauguration, discover the hackathon challenges, collaborate with talented peers, and challenge yourself to build something meaningful in 24 hours.

Bring your ideas. Build with your team. Innovate at Kurukshetra.

Organized by Devkraft × CSI
